upgrade_governance.schema_versioning_rule: Increment schema_descriptor_version when watched spec source changes. Use major for breaking/semantic-family changes, minor for additive optional fields, patch for descriptions/source metadata.
upgrade_governance.srs_evolution_rule: Never overwrite canonical nodes directly. Create candidate_delta, run SDNF gates, produce accepted/rejected/deferred decisions, then append lineage.
upgrade_governance.runtime_compliance_rule: Payment-initiation allow decisions should use approved schema versions only. Inferred or changed schemas remain diagnostic/provisional until reviewed or threshold-gated.

normal_forms_for_upgrade.ECNF: sufficient evidence from spec + payload + constraints
normal_forms_for_upgrade.CMNF: domain/rail separation, e.g., card vs UPI vs ISO20022
normal_forms_for_upgrade.DBNF: drift across schema/spec versions and embedding/model versions
normal_forms_for_upgrade.PONF: partition separation, e.g., identifier vs method vs status vs temporal

notes: These are SDNF schema descriptors for experiment/onboarding, not vendor-certified official JSON schemas.
They combine public documentation cues with the attached sample payload field universe.
Use payload files separately as ECNF/value-evidence inputs.
Each schema includes spec monitoring metadata so future provider/standard changes can be tracked and converted into SRS evolution deltas.

spec_monitoring.canonical_spec_strategy: Track Stripe changelog/API upgrades and PaymentIntent object docs. Stripe changelog explicitly tracks API changes and upgrades; API versions and breaking changes should trigger schema version updates.

change_policy.on_new_field_in_spec: classify semantic_family, add as candidate attribute, run SDNF gates before merging into canonical node
change_policy.on_type_or_constraint_change: create new schema version, run payload regression, mark breaking if requiredness/type/pattern changes
change_policy.on_deprecation: retain legacy mapping with deprecated=true until payload evidence shows safe removal
